messages:
partner-eng-bob: Heads-up — SigmaHealth SI hit a blocker during on-prem wiring. Their DB sits behind a corporate DB proxy + internal-only DNS. Redwood Private agent can't reach their DB via the PrivateLink path. They need an architecture decision today :rotating_light:

maria g.: Oof. Is the proxy doing TLS termination or MITM (mTLS)?

partner-eng-bob: Proxy does TLS termination, and they enforce outbound through a forward proxy that injects certs. No mTLS between app and DB.

jonathan: So two issues: (1) DNS resolution for private hostname, (2) egress required to reach PrivateLink endpoint. Which one is failing exactly?

partner-eng-bob: Both. From their test container: `psql -h internal-db.sigma.local -U app` times out. `dig internal-db.sigma.local` returns private -> doesn't resolve in our managed subnet. And their security team refuses to open wide egress to 0.0.0.0/0.

ali: Do they have a NAT gateway + route to PrivateLink? If not, PrivateLink won't be in their HTTP proxy allowlist.

carla: Could we suggest using our VPC-hosted resolver + conditional forwarder? Or push a small resolver sidecar in the customer's subnet?

kevin: Sidecar is ok but they want minimal infra changes. Quick option: set up a proxied TCP relay on our side that the agent can connect outbound to, then we tunnel to their DB over an SSM-like session. But that adds compliance questions.

maria g.: @kevin — what's the compliance delta? SigmaHealth is sensitive PHI, so any relay needs approved logging, no plaintext, and KMS usage.

kevin: Understood. We can require mTLS to the relay and enforce mutual auth backed by customer-managed KMS. Logs stored to their S3 with encryption. Still needs legal review.

jonathan: Alternative: ask them to add conditional rules to their forward proxy to allow the PrivateLink endpoint FQDN/IPs and configure their DNS to resolve internal-db.sigma.local to our provided IP (via split-horizon). They said they can't edit DNS zones though.

partner-eng-bob: Correct — DNS change is blocked. Security only allows proxy rules or an approved agent pattern.

ali: Then the least friction path is to provision a customer-dedicated ingress endpoint inside their VPC — a slim agent that initiates an outbound mTLS tunnel to our infra (egress-only). That respects their outbound policy and avoids DNS edits.

carla: Can we provide Terraform snippet they can apply quickly? If so, SI can push it and we can run a quick arch review.

# example: simple egress-only agent
resource "aws_instance" "redwood_agent" {
  ami           = "ami-12345"
  instance_type = "t3.small"
  subnet_id     = "${var.private_subnet}"
  user_data     = <<-EOF
    #!/bin/bash
    /usr/local/bin/redwood-agent --mode=egress --cert /etc/agent/cert.pem
  EOF
}

kevin: That snippet works as a starting point. Couple of notes: need to expose port 443 outbound, and ensure the forward proxy allows CONNECT to our egress domain.

maria g.: Sigma's security says they can add a proxy ACL for `connect.redwood-inference.com` but not add DNS records. So we can run the tunnel as `connect.redwood-inference.com:443` and the forward proxy will permit it.

partner-eng-bob: Great — I'll coordinate the SI to deploy the agent. Can infra/security provide an architecture sign-off doc we can attach to the SOW?

jonathan: I'll draft a short arch note listing assumptions, required proxy ACLs, certs, and KMS bindings. Will ping legal after infra sign-off.

infra-bot: Created ticket RI-3427 — "SigmaHealth SI: DB proxy / egress tunnel for Private deployment" assigned to eng-platform.https://redwood/ops/RI-3427

carla: If we move forward, let's schedule a 30-min hangout with Sigma sec + SI + eng-platform tomorrow. Quick sync to approve the agent pattern and cert rotation cadence.

partner-eng-bob: booked: Tue 10:30 PT. I'll send calendar and pre-read (arch note + terraform). Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

maria g.: Adding checklist for deployment: 1) proxy ACL for `connect.redwood-inference.com`, 2) agent AMI + IAM role, 3) KMS key policy, 4) log bucket + lifecycle, 5) cert provisioning flow.

kevin: I'll prepare the AMI + minimal agent config and drop link in the ticket.

jonathan: Uploading arch note to the ticket now. https://redwood/ops/RI-3427/arch-note

partner-eng-bob: SI confirmed — they can get proxy ACL change in 24h once we share FQDN/IPs. Closing loop here for now.

carla: Thanks — mark as blocked->waiting-proxy in the delivery tracker.

infra-bot: Ticket RI-3427 updated: status=waiting-proxy; updated_by=jonathan; ts=1799990299"
